Identified as this saint because: Studenica donor fresco of Stefan Nemanja, grand zupan, "in monasticism named Symeon", filed under Category:Frescos of Saint Simeon the Myrovlytes — the folder's own identification of Simeon with Stefan Nemanja. Commons describes it: Donor's portrait of Stefan Nemanje, Great Zupan (1168-1196), in monasticsm named Symeon. Fresco in the Church of the Theotokos, Studenica Monastery (1568). The saint is shown wearing both the monarch's crown and the simple robes of a monk. He holds a model of the church he has donated.
